Hi Rodrigo, it's Claire. Tom and I are going to visit the plant in Sorocaba next month. I have two quick questions about the new rules. First, do we have to do the safety training before the visit? Second, do we have to bring a helmet, or do you have helmets for visitors? Please let me know. Thanks!

Hi Claire, it's Rodrigo. Thanks for your message. Yes, you have to do the safety training, but it is short: only twenty minutes, online. You don't have to bring a helmet. We have helmets for all visitors at the entrance. And remember: you have to wear your badge all the time. See you next month!

Claire sent an email with the new rules for plant visits. Rodrigo read the email with his team. Tom and Claire did the online safety training. The plant director approved the visit one week before. At the plant, the visitors wore a badge and a helmet. After the visit, Claire signed the report online.
